items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 — DeepMind's most capable robot action model
items.summary: DeepMind's newest robot model learns fine hand skills like tying bows and serving food with tongs.

items.title: Gemini for healthcare — Google Cloud's agent for clinical and payer work
items.summary: Google Cloud's Gemini agent for hospitals and health plans, now in U.S. preview.

items.title: AlphaProof Code — DeepMind AI verifies the Signal protocol's code
items.summary: A multi-LLM agent system that produces machine-checked Lean proofs that real software is correct.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'Is Software Over?'
items.summary: Two Minute Papers looks at AI that can rebuild existing software without seeing its source code.

items.title: LongCat-2.5 — Meituan opens weights of its 1.6T agentic model
items.summary: Meituan's LongCat-2.5 puts a 1.6T multimodal agent model on Hugging Face under the MIT license.

items.title: Gemini human review — excerpts from your Gmail and Drive can reach reviewers
items.summary: Google now says human reviewers can see excerpts of Gmail and Drive content that consumer Gemini pulls into a chat.

items.title: e-means — Meta FAIR's k-means replacement needs one-tenth the epochs
items.summary: A drop-in k-means replacement from Meta FAIR that reaches the same clustering loss in about a tenth of the passes over the data.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.322 — fast mode comes to Google Vertex AI
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.322 lets teams on Google Vertex AI use fast mode, with a safe fallback to normal speed.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'NOTHING will be smarter than Fable 5.2...'
items.summary: Wes Roth reads the fine print of the Claude Fable 5.2 launch and tests the model live.

items.title: TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max — Google adds a confidential TPU and a dual-chip TPU
items.summary: Google's TPU line gets a secure inference system for sensitive data and a denser chip for very long context.

items.title: Fireworks AI breach widens — customer datasets and model weights accessed
items.summary: Fireworks AI's October breach turned out bigger: billing data, and for some customers, datasets and unfinished fine-tuned weights.

items.title: OpenAI Control Room — a fail-closed off switch for research model workloads
items.summary: OpenAI moved its emergency stop into the inference layer, so a halted research job cannot get another token from any model.

items.title: Fireship — 'OpenAI spent $1.2 million hacking Linux... and it was a bargain'
items.summary: A Fireship breakdown of OpenAI's agent pipeline that found 948 Linux kernel root exploits.

items.title: Muse Ember — Meta's smallest Muse model for agent sub-tasks
items.summary: Muse Ember is Meta's cheapest Muse model, made to run the many small steps inside an AI agent.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.321 — Fable 5.2 as the default Fable model, MCP OAuth fix
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.321 brings Claude Fable 5.2 into the CLI and closes several permission and token-leak gaps.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 — Anthropic's new top model, $8/$40 and 30% faster
items.summary: Anthropic's top-end Claude gets 20% cheaper, up to 30% faster, and jumps on agentic coding and knowledge-work tests.

items.title: llama-modchip 2.4 — 284B DeepSeek-V4-Flash on a 64 GB CPU, no GPU
items.summary: Run a 284B open MoE model on a 64 GB desktop CPU, with a 256K context and no graphics card.

items.title: Arete-27B — Nous Research strips state propaganda from Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: An open 27B model tuned to answer politically sensitive questions with facts instead of state talking points.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'NVIDIA's Secret 2 Bit Model' on Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B
items.summary: A walkthrough of why NVIDIA's 2-bit Nemotron 3.5 Bolt works when most sub-4-bit models break.

items.title: Claude Code 'Don't Ask Again' — passwords leak in 1,122 public GitHub files
items.summary: Approved shell commands, saved word for word, put real passwords into public GitHub repos.

items.title: OpenAI hires Hacktron — the team that hacked it now tests its systems
items.summary: Two months after Hacktron used AI to reach OpenAI's internal repo, OpenAI hired it to keep looking.

items.title: Microsoft Research Closes AI Frontiers — the group behind Autogen
items.summary: Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group, home of Autogen and Fara, is shutting down after a reorganization into Microsoft AI.

items.title: Two Minute Papers — 'OpenAI's Astra Just Opened The Black Box Of AI'
items.summary: Two Minute Papers explains how GPT-6 Astra reads a network's weights and rewrites them directly.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Hy4 Beats it's Preview Easily'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen gives a first look at Tencent's full Hunyuan Hy4 release.

items.title: BioBasicsBench — OpenAI tests AI agents on everyday wet-lab data
items.summary: OpenAI's BioBasicsBench checks whether AI agents can read gels, colony plates and microscopy from real lab work.
